data.gender_notes: Akhilraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akhilraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Akshar' (letter, syllable, or symbol) and 'Raj' (ruler or king). The name symbolizes the one who rules over all the letters and syllables of the universe. The name Akhilraj carries the meaning “Ruler of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akhilraj usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of cosmic consciousness and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Akhilraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akhilraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
